title: Model Supply Maps and Strategic Response Playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a repeatable playbook and artifacts to map model availability across vendors and public checkpoints, surface short-to-medium term threats (0-3 months, 3-9 months, 9-18 months), and define proactive product and GTM responses. This ticket covers data collection schema, scoring rubric, primary dashboard queries, escalation SOPs for high-risk signals, and handoff to Growth/Field for messaging and to Engineering for operational mitigations.
objectives: Produce a Model Supply Map that shows vendor capacity, license constraints, quantized variants, and known inference-ready checkpoints
Define a competitor threat horizon with concrete indicators for near-term disruption vs long-term strategic risk
Ship a lightweight dashboard and alerting rules that PMs and SREs can operationalize
Align cross-functional owners and GTM playbooks for high-severity incidents
deliverables: Model Supply Map CSV and canonical schema (vendor, model, weights-url, quant, throughput-profile, license, last-seen)
Threat Horizon matrix with scoring and example signals
Dashboard: model-availability (Prometheus/SIEM + BigQuery queries) and alert rule set
SOP: escalation flow, customer messaging templates, rollback/fallback model playbook
One-page GTM brief for Growth and Solutions teams
acceptance_criteria: Canonical supply map uploaded to /redwood-internal/models/supply/ with weekly refresh process documented
Dashboard returns actionable signals (e.g., vendor takedown, license change, sudden drop in public checkpoints) and a test alert fires to #pm-alerts channel
Threat Horizon includes at least 12 vendor/model entries with scoring rationale and assigned owners
GTM brief reviewed by Growth and Legal with sign-off from Product and Security
risks: Incomplete or stale external metadata leading to false negatives/positives
License changes that require legal signoff and slow reactive time
Over-alerting causing alert fatigue in oncall and PM channels
signals_to_monitor: Public repo: sudden removal of weights or license change
Telemetry: large uptick in inference errors or latencies when routing to a nearby vendor/model
Community chatter: sharp increase in GitHub/GG discussions or model forks
Cloud marketplace listings: new dedicated offerings or prebuilt endpoints announced
Research benchmarks: new SOTA results that materially change model selection
proposed_dashboard_queries: BQ: SELECT vendor, model, COUNT(*) as checkpoints_last_30d FROM model_registry.checkpoints WHERE last_seen >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY vendor, model
Slack alert rule: if supply_map.missing_count_by_vendor > 5 -> notify #pm-alerts and #sre

notes: Prefer conservative scoring for horizon (bias towards false positives) to avoid surprises.
We will prioritize models that appear in >3 public forks or have prebuilt endpoints in marketplaces.
Consider a 'fallback ladder' in runtime to map equivalent models across vendors for automatic routing.
Follow-up ticket recommended to integrate supply map with runtime routing rules (ENG-20011 suggested).
